purpose: Read, write and Git-sync a user-designated MemHub memory repository.

filesystem.pathEscape: rejected: absolute paths and `..` sequences are refused

shell.secretInArguments: never; git authorization is passed through the child-process environment

network.default: no automatic egress until `sync setup` or `onboard` is run explicitly
network.thirdPartyBroker: used only when the user names the host via --broker-url or a MEMHUB_*_OAUTH_BROKER_URL variable

mutations.destructive: none: `forget` soft-archives (status=archived); no file deletion and no history rewrite

credentials.storage: outside ${MEMHUB_REPO}, file mode 0600 in a 0700 directory
credentials.oauthState: generated per authorization attempt and verified on the callback
